A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] worked as '''technician''' on the [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Fleet]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] on-board the [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Fleet]]. A blue-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] man with a [[Color/Legends|ginger]] [[Hair/Legends|mustache]] and fair skin, the technician worked at the main hangar of the ''Redemption'' two months following the pivotal [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He was secretly contemptuous of the young [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], refusing to consider her as a full-fledged soldier of the Alliance. After Organa returned to the ''Redemption'' following a [[mission to the Dominus sector]], she handed her [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] to the technician and asked him to take care of her [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. The technician made a sarcastic comment behind her back, but was overheard by Organa's [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] and fledgling [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Skywalker informed the man about Organa's action during the mission, and the technician apologized to the pilot.

The technician wore tan fatigues and a helmet while on duty.

==Behind the scenes==
The technician appears in the first issue of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[2013]] title, [[Star Wars (2013)|''Star Wars'']].
